name: yogatik-studio
description: Yogatik Studio — Standalone Unrestricted AI Agentic Assistant & Desktop Environment

scripts.dev:all: pnpm run dev & pnpm run dev:electron
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:shared && pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:electron
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:shared && pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:electron
scripts.test: pnpm run test:shared && pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:electron
scripts.test:watch: pnpm run test:watch:shared & pnpm run test:watch:web & pnpm run test:watch:electron
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter @my-app/shared-ui clean && pnpm --filter @my-app/web-app clean && pnpm --filter @my-app/desktop-electron clean
